annotations.title: Check EU CBAM scope of a CN code

description: EU CBAM: is a product (CN code) in scope, which aggregated goods category, are indirect emissions counted, and its EU default value for the country of production. Use the 8-digit CN code of the customs declaration (4/6 digits give a partial answer).
